UN.wiki: An intergovernmental organization whose stated purposes are to maintain international peace and security.

DEFCON.wiki: An alert state used by the United States Armed Forces. DEFCON 1 is maximum readiness, meaning nuclear war is imminent or has already started.

USA.wiki: The world's foremost economic and military superpower.

EU.wiki: A political and economic union of 27 member states that are located primarily in Europe.

UK.wiki: A sovereign country in Europe, off the north-western coast of the continental mainland.
